name: Chipo's Hardware & Home
bio: Family-run hardware store stocking power tools, paint, tiles and everything you need to finish your next project — with honest advice and next-day delivery around Chitungwiza.

blocks.tagline: Tools, paint, tiles & everything for your next project
blocks.hero: Browse the shelves on WhatsApp or walk in — our team will help you pick the right materials, mix your paint and load your bakkie. Stock updates every morning.
blocks.services:
Paint mixing & colour matching
Key cutting & padlocks
Free quotes on tiling & plaster
Next-day delivery around Chitungwiza
Bulk pricing for builders & schools
Tool repairs & battery refits

faq.a: Yes — free around Makoni and Unit L, and a flat $5 further out in Chitungwiza. Same-day if you order before 10am.

faq.q: Can I get a quote on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Absolutely. Send us a photo of your list or bill of quantities and we'll price it the same day.
Yes — cash, EcoCash, and card at the till. Larger orders can go on 7-day terms for regulars.

testimonials.comment: Bought a drill and paint for our kitchen reno — the team even colour-matched to our curtain fabric. Delivery was next morning.
testimonials.name: Rudo M.

testimonials.comment: Best prices on tiles in Chitungwiza. They loaded everything into my truck and threw in the spacers for free.
testimonials.name: Tendai K.

testimonials.comment: Great hardware, gets busy on Saturdays so WhatsApp first — they'll have your order packed and waiting.
testimonials.name: Munyaradzi C.
